svg.text: hanbit_mart · Hanbit Mart, Hapjeong store (+ hanbit_mart_breakroom, mart_street)
Ground-floor plan in metres, north up. Western Hapjeong-dong, Mapo-gu: corner of a 2-lane street and a side lane (fictional shop, no real address). Shop ceiling 2.8 m.
1 Glass door, opens IN; bell above (JINGLE)
2 Counter: till, card reader, Taeo's coffee cup;
customers stand on its west side
5 Small TV, mounted high (2.0 m) on the east
wall, angled at the counter (screen: green)
7 Noodle gondola: cup noodles on the aisle-1
face, packet noodles on the aisle-2 face,
8 Promo end cap with the red sale tag (P07–08)
10 Wall shelves: rice, oil, sauces, tissue
11 Drinks fridges, 3 glass doors (end of aisle 2)
25 Staff WC 26 Back door to the lane
29 Plastic crates 30 Bicycle on the utility pole
31 Corner sign; fascia = green panel + white
